notes: Myanmar has NO VAT, so the VAT fields are null. The Commercial Tax (Union Taxation Law 2026, s.14(i)) charges 3% on pure gold (bars, blocks, coins) AND gold jewellery, on sale proceeds and import landed value, with no input set-off. Silver is never mentioned and takes the general 5% CT rate. The s.14(a)/(d) exemption lists were read in full. Duty null.

sources.name: Internal Revenue Department (ird.gov.mm) - Union Taxation Law 2026, s.14(i)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: commercial tax of 3 percent applies to pure gold (standard gold bars, gold blocks, gold coins) and gold jewellery, domestically and on importation
sources.quote: Commercial tax shall be charged at the rate 3 percent on the sale proceeds of the pure gold (standard gold bars, gold blocks, gold coins) jewellery made of gold and also on their landed value for importation.
